content.text:
Ozan here. Caruso's tonight for Ingrid's promotion. I'm heads-down in a code freeze till six, so put my end of the sheet in - and read my notes. Also, from Rosa: Caruso's seats the whole party at the chef's counter at seven and cooks from one pre-order sheet filed under her name - every guest gets their own row, and anything for the table (the boards, the platters) rides Rosa's row per the house convention on the menu. Service and the big-party gratuity go on the org card at the restaurant and don't touch the sheet, so open the cart without typing a limit - the account carries exactly what the org loaded for tonight.

Caruso's locks the fire order at 6:00, twenty-one minutes from now, and a sheet that isn't locked in by then is nobody's dinner tonight.
Nothing further from me for now.
[text from Ozan] Just saw the Caruso's confirmation land - what did we end up with?
